summary: A panel that slides in from any edge and closes by swipe, with a title, description and body.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: A glyph beside the trigger's label.

props.name: triggerIconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger `triggerIcon` sits at.

props.name: title
props.description: The drawer's heading, wired up by Base UI's own Drawer.Title.

props.name: description
props.example: Markdown, 4 KB. Edited today and kept in Documents.
props.description: The body text, wired up by Base UI's own Drawer.Description.

props.name: children
props.description: The body, below the description. Style it yourself.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: A full-width button at the end that closes the drawer. None renders without it.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides in from, and the direction a swipe closes it.

props.name: handle
props.description: A grab bar on the edge facing the page, for a `bottom` or `top` drawer.

props.name: showClose
props.description: An X in the corner. A swipe, a click outside and Esc close it either way.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and text size of the trigger and the close button, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the edge that faces the page, and on the buttons.

props.name: animated
props.description: The slide in and out and the backdrop's fade. A swipe follows the finger either way.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the drawer is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.
